company.name: The Home Depot, Inc.
company.fiscalCalendar: Home Depot uses a 52/53-week retail fiscal calendar; fiscal 2026 first quarter ended May 3, 2026, so FY2026Q2 is the following fiscal quarter.

sources.title: The Home Depot Announces First Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results; Reaffirms Fiscal 2026 Guidance

businessModel.claim: The Home Depot is the world's largest home improvement retailer, selling to consumers and professional (Pro) customers through retail stores plus SRS distribution locations.

productsAndCustomers.claim: The company serves DIY consumers and professional customers, and reports customer transactions and average ticket as core demand measures.

segmentsAndGeographies.claim: At the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2026 the company operated 2,361 retail stores and over 1,280 SRS locations across the U.S., its territories, Canada and Mexico.

fiscalCalendar.claim: The first quarter of fiscal 2026 ended May 3, 2026 (three months ended May 3, 2026), so the requested FY2026Q2 forecast period is the following fiscal quarter.

revenueAndCostDrivers.claim: Sales are driven by comparable sales (comparable customer transactions and comparable average ticket), new store openings and foreign exchange, with the release breaking out these drivers.

accountingDefinitions.claim: The company reports under GAAP and defines adjusted diluted earnings per share as a non-GAAP measure that excludes acquired intangible asset amortization and related tax effects.

guidanceStyle.claim: Home Depot gives full-year fiscal guidance as ranges (e.g. total sales growth of approximately 2.5% to 4.5% and comparable sales growth of approximately flat to 2.0%) rather than explicit quarterly guidance.

cyclicalityAndSeasonality.claim: Results are sensitive to the state of the housing and home improvement markets and consumer demand, with management citing housing affordability pressure and consumer uncertainty.

externalExposures.claim: The company identifies tariffs, trade policy changes or restrictions, interest rates, foreign currency exchange rates and macroeconomic conditions as external risks to its outlook.

signalMap.signal: Most recent reported quarterly net sales (proxy anchor)
signalMap.hypothesis: Home Depot does not issue explicit quarterly net-sales guidance, so the most recent reported quarter (Q1 fiscal 2026 net sales of $41.8bn / $41,765m) is used as a proxy starting range for the next fiscal quarter, consistent with reaffirmed full-year sales growth of approximately 2.5% to 4.5%.
signalMap.freshnessRequirement: latest available reported figure before cutoff

signalMap.signal: Most recent reported adjusted diluted EPS (proxy anchor)
signalMap.hypothesis: No explicit quarterly EPS guidance is given, so the most recent reported adjusted diluted EPS (Q1 fiscal 2026 of $3.43) is used as a proxy starting range for the next fiscal quarter, consistent with reaffirmed full-year adjusted diluted EPS growth of approximately flat to 4.0%.
signalMap.freshnessRequirement: latest available reported figure before cutoff

signalMap.hypothesis: Home Depot's reaffirmed fiscal 2026 comparable sales guidance of approximately flat to 2.0% is management's directly applicable range for total company comparable sales and is used as the starting range for FY2026Q2.
